Sam (PM): quick async check for Q2 OKR milestone: runtime-v3 rollout — want a short status: what shipped, what slipped, owners, blockers, PRs to merge. tagging eng leads and infra.
Alex (Eng Lead): shipped -> canary for two model families (gpt-small, gpt-med) in us-west. perf looks inline with targets.
Alex (Eng Lead): slipped -> quantized 8-bit path for long-context models (gpt-long) hit perf regression on nv-cu116. lab repro failing. owner: Mira.
Mira (ML Eng): confirmed regression. tracking in #eng-ml ticket 2345. root cause: kernel scheduling difference under continuous batching. ETA for patch + perf tests: ~10 business days.
Mira (ML Eng): mitigation: can disable quantized path for gpt-long on nv-cu116; fallback to fp16 while we fix. need infra toggle from Kevin.
Kevin (Infra): can add a runtime feature flag. I can deploy a per-model toggle by EOD tomorrow. PR: infra/feature-flags#482 — needs code review.
Taylor (Eng): I can review infra PR today, pinging @Kevin for checklist. also have two small runtime patches blocked on that flag: rtm/runtime#129 and rtm/runtime#130.
Taylor (Eng): quick Q: any SLA-facing customers using gpt-long on cu116? want to know if we should prioritize the quick fallback.
Sam (PM): yes — Payments team has a small pilot on cu116; recommend fallback until patch.
Alex (Eng Lead): next steps summary (short):
```
- Rollback quantized gpt-long on nv-cu116 -> fallback fp16 (Kevin)
- Kevin deploys flag and toggle (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Taylor reviews infra PR + merges runtime patches (ETA: today/tomorrow)
- Mira runs perf regression tests and posts results (ETA: 10 business days)
- Sam to notify Payments pilot and update OKR doc
```
Mira (ML Eng): will post perf run summary to this thread when ready.
Taylor (Eng): started code review now, should be done before standup tomorrow. @Alex want me to merge or wait for you?
Alex (Eng Lead): merge once CI green and Kevin confirms deploy flag exists.
Kevin (Infra): noted. I'll comment on infra/feature-flags#482 when the toggle is live and add the rollout steps.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for feature-flags branch infra/feature-flags#482 — build started (job 9876).
Sam (PM): thanks team — this is a good short plan. I'll update the OKR artifact and mark "partial ship" for the milestone (canary shipped; gpt-long quantization slipped). Will follow up in 2 days for status. :thumbsup:
Alex (Eng Lead): ping me if Payments reports any regression after fallback.
Mira (ML Eng): adding test matrix to the ticket now.
Taylor (Eng): merged rtm/runtime#129 and #130, CI green. tagging for deploy.
Kevin (Infra): build succeeded, feature flag deployed to us-west canary at 5109880000. rolling to prod will wait for Alex sign-off.
Sam (PM): perfect — closing this async check. if anything changes, reply here.
